author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
This time, just for a bit of fun, I want to try to make a pie crust completely from scratch, start to finish in under 30 minutes.  The filling will be ready made, but the crust is the challenge!

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for FREE early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp
Atomic Shrimp subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/AtomicShrimp/
